patterns.message: SY22: prefer tenantDb/requireMembership from '@/lib/tenant'. Raw db bypasses tenant scoping; only lib/tenant.ts, lib/platform/**, scripts/**, prisma/** should import it directly. Existing importers migrate opportunistically.

no-restricted-syntax.message: SY25: raw hex colours are not allowed in components. Use a token from packages/tokens (Tailwind: bg-syncit-bond, text-syncit-ink, …; mobile: theme.colors.<name>) or add a new token to tokens.json and regenerate.
